name: alert
description: A callout for important, static information — supports an icon, title, description, and an optional action. `variant` sets the surface (`outline`, the default, `soft` or `solid`) and `tone` the color (`neutral`, `primary`, `brand`, `success`, `warning`, `info` or `destructive`; the default is primary for solid, neutral otherwise). Status alerts are usually `soft` in the status tone; `solid` with `tone="brand"` is for announcements and promos in the theme's second identity color.
